definition: Thought has an affirmative/denying sign and a proposition content. Object obtains exactly when that proposition holds. TrueThought and FalseThought follow the sign-sensitive composition clauses, with all four signed truth/falsity controls populated. This explicit interpretation can coexist with the full earlier stage-proof framework; it is not historical identity or philosophical equivalence.
